cases.subject: Bot Crash – Bots 14168 & 12920 | Location 005.139
cases.Description:
Hi GO Team,

We had a crash at location 005.139 involving Bot 14168 (carrying MSU 2024) and Bot 12920 (carrying MSU 2904).
Time: between 15:40 to 16:00
It was clear that Bot 14168 was responsible for the collision. I recovered the bot and moved it to the maintenance cage for further investigation.

One unusual observation: At the time of the crash, the system showed Bot 14168’s location approximately 10 barcodes to the right of its actual position, significantly away from the crash location.

Please investigate both the collision and the location discrepancy.

Thank you,



Harry Beik

Specialist Technician | Service & Mantenance

Aritzia

7233 Progress Way, Delta, BC V4G 1E7

hbeik@aritzia.com | aritzia.com

cases.Subject: HMSS - UD Decon Put Away - Mark Full Option Missing and Quantity Update Not Working at Station 9
cases.subject: HMSS - UD Decon Put Away - Mark Full Option Missing and Quantity Update Not Working at Station 9
cases.Description:
Hi Team,

Can you please check the below issue with the UD Decon Put Away process at Station 9?

Issue 1: Mark Full Option Missing

At Station 9, we are performing User Directed (UD) Put Away for Decons.
The station is using the newer TTP UI.
Unlike Station 10, the "Mark Full" option is not available at Station 9.
This creates an operational challenge because users are unable to put away all items from a tote into a bin using the Mark Full functionality.
At Station 10, which is running the older GTP UI, the Mark Full option is available and functioning correctly for the same UD Decon Put Away process.

Issue 2: Quantity Change Not Reflected

At Station 9, when the user changes the put away quantity (for example from 1 to 2) before confirming the slot, the system still processes and displays that only 1 quantity was put away.
A video and screenshot have been attached demonstrating the behavior.

Request:

Please verify why the Mark Full option is not available on Station 9.
Please investigate the quantity update issue where the entered quantity is not being reflected correctly after confirmation.
Kindly confirm whether this is an expected behavior, configuration issue, or application defect.

Station Affected: Station 9

Attachments: Video and screenshot demonstrating both issues.

cases.Subject: Request for Permanent Removal of Barcode 001.011 from Butler Mapping
cases.subject: Request for Permanent Removal of Barcode 001.011 from Butler Mapping
cases.Description:
Hi,

We would like to request the permanent removal of barcode 001.011 from the Butler mapping

Barcode 001.011 must not be used as a travel path or parking position for any Butler, as Butler movement over or onto this location causes recurring issues

At present, we have had to create and position a fictitious Butler on barcode 001.011 in the system to prevent other Butlers from travelling over or parking on this location

This is only a workaround and means that we cannot use this Butler in normal operation

We do not require further support or troubleshooting for this issue

We have investigated and worked with this problem through support for several years, and the permanent solution we require is simply to remove/disable barcode 001.011 from the mapping, ensuring that it is excluded from all Butler routing

Once barcode 001.011 has been permanently removed from the mapping, we can remove the fictitious occupancy and return the Butler currently used for this purpose to normal operation

Please arrange for 001.011 to be permanently removed or blocked in the mapping/routing system

Thank you in advance.

cases.Subject: GTP - PPTL light data for Put stations
cases.subject: GTP - PPTL light data for Put stations
cases.Description:
Hello GO Team,
We understand that the current setup for the PPTL lights at the Put Station displays the item count for a tote only when an associate scans that tote for put-away.
However, each roll cage contains 8 totes, and the remaining totes show a count of zero until they are individually scanned.
Our request is to determine whether it is possible for the PPTL system to display the item counts for all totes on the roll cage as soon as the roll cage is inducted into the Put PPS Station, rather than requiring each tote to be scanned individually.
Could you please let us know if this functionality is possible?

cases.subject: HMSS - Reslot Inventory Showing in GTP Listing Instead of Reserve Listing
cases.Description:
issue after performing a reslot for the below SKU.

Reslot Details:

SKU: 1200810005240009
HU: 1050652
Pick Subject: pick-sujentestreslot1200810005240009-1791224261517000
Internal Put SR: 334901525
Reserve Put Location: 5-A1.0.B.06

The reslot activity was completed successfully and the inventory was put away to the reserve location mentioned above. However, upon verification, the inventory is currently appearing in the GTP Listing with the reserve location displayed.

Expected behavior is for the inventory to appear under the Reserve Listing after the reslot is completed and the stock is moved to the reserve location.

Please investigate why the inventory is being shown in the GTP Listing instead of the Reserve Listing and advise.

cases.Subject: Follow-up to case 00285524 — Recent BRSP15 zone operation latency evidence
cases.subject: Follow-up to case 00285524 — Recent BRSP15 zone operation latency evidence
cases.Description:
Hi Team,

We are opening this ticket to continue the investigation previously reported in case 00285524, which has been closed.

The original case reported recurring latency in pause operations, particularly for Zone-11 at BRSP15. In your latest responses, you requested more recent instances with explicit timestamps and timezone, as your log retention period is limited to 30 days.

We now have the following recent instances from BRSP15. These instances correspond to resume operations, and we would like you to investigate whether they are related to the behavior reported in the original case.

All timestamps below are in UTC.

The corresponding GreyOrange endpoint URLs are:

https://brffsp15-prod.greymatter.greyorange.com/api-gateway/maop-service/zone/Zone-13/resume

https://brffsp15-prod.greymatter.greyorange.com/api-gateway/maop-service/zone/Zone-14/resume

https://brffsp15-prod.greymatter.greyorange.com/api-gateway/maop-service/zone/Zone-11/resume

We are attaching a JSON file for each instance containing the case ID, UTC timestamp, trace ID, span ID, parent ID, request path, corresponding GreyOrange URL, and measured duration.

Could you please review your logs around these timestamps and help us identify what contributed to these response times? Please also confirm the expected response time for these operations and whether zone configuration, associated resources, active rules, operational status, or internal queues could affect their duration.

Thanks.

cases.Description:
In the example shown, our ERP system (SAP) reports a warehouse stock of 84 pieces, while 467 pieces are still pending receipt into the system. Conversely, the warehouse management system already considers these 467 pieces as being in stock.

As a temporary workaround, we must manually force the posting of the 467 pieces in SAP to align the inventory balances between the two systems.

We have identified several similar cases of this type.

cases.subject: SRE-26564 Re: Urgent request: Confirmation of security patching and exposure status
cases.Description:
Nitesh Saini commented:

Hi Ganesh,

We conducted an initial assessment to verify PHP usage across our applications and infrastructure.


*


*Application Review:* Confirmed that PHP is not used in our GreyMatter and gstore applications.
*Source Code Verification:* Reviewed the relevant GitHub repositories and found no traces of PHP files.
*SIEM Validation:* Checked running processes through our SIEM solution and found no evidence of active PHP processes.

cases.Description:
Hi Team,

*Reported Issue:  *Attached is a video and an excel file with Data with the
test cases highlighted in yellow. This video shows what is happening, when
two small tickets are inducted for the same ranger then there is a delay,
then the ranger circles back into the induct queue. And there is no record
of the scan attempt.

the video was recorded at 1352 EST on June 24th 2026
 on ranger 7018


when one of these Dillard's cases with two labels are inducted 1 at a time
it sorts it just fine fyi, it is just when there is one of these Dillard's
with two labels, with any other small ticket sort

I think the issue stems from the 1-4 sorting rules originally set up as
these cases weren't part of the implementation data we had at that time.

the cases causing the issues do fall under Rule 2 AND Rule 3



Rule1: Accept any code beginning with 1Z, max 256 chars
Rule2: Accept any 34-character code beginning with 1 or 96
Rule3: Accept any 20-digit numeric code beginning with 00008
Rule4: Accept any 10-digit numeric code

OLD Cases: 258941


Thanks,
Raushan Kumar

the video was recorded at 1352 EST on June 24th 2026
 on ranger 7018


when one of these Dillard's cases with two labels are inducted 1 at a time
it sorts it just fine fyi, it is just when there is one of these Dillard's
with two labels, with any other small ticket sort

I think the issue stems from the 1-4 sorting rules originally set up as
these cases weren't part of the implementation data we had at that time.

the cases causing the issues do fall under Rule 2 AND Rule 3



Rule1: Accept any code beginning with 1Z, max 256 chars
Rule2: Accept any 34-character code beginning with 1 or 96
Rule3: Accept any 20-digit numeric code beginning with 00008
Rule4: Accept any 10-digit numeric code

Thanks,
Raushan Kumar

Hi @Customer Assistance Cell <cac@greyorange.com> ,

We have scheduled a technical alignment meeting with Coupang regarding the
upcoming Teleport (PAM) migration for INC4 and INC14.

*Meeting Details:*

   -

   *Date:* October 27 (Tuesday)
   -

   *Time:* 5:30–6:30 PM KST (2:00–3:00 PM IST)
   -

   *Zoom:*
   https://greyorange.zoom.us/j/85387527218?pwd=3RoByoXBUsQ5IjzW9NaIa14MGyAjxd.1&jst=2
   -

   *Jira:* https://greyorange-work.atlassian.net/browse/SRE-25963

*Action Required from SRE:*

   1.

   *Please align and confirm who from the SRE team can join the meeting at
   the scheduled time.*
   2.

   Please thoroughly review *SRE-25963* and the associated Teleport
   migration requirements before the meeting.
   3.

   Come prepared to validate the proposed access methods, technical

infrastructure and access-related requirements need to be validated by the
SRE team.

Given Coupang's migration deadline of *October 30*, please prioritize this
review and confirm the SRE representative who will attend.

Best Regards,
Minjong Kim

alerts.Subject: Prod Platform Core H&M Canada – Rapid Disk Utilization Due to Tomcat Log Growth
alerts.subject: Prod Platform Core H&M Canada – Rapid Disk Utilization Due to Tomcat Log Growth
alerts.Description:
**Issue:**

While monitoring the disk utilization for **prod-platform-core – H&M Canada**, we observed continuous growth in the `/opt` partition due to rapid generation of Tomcat logs.

**Findings:**

* `/opt/tomcat/logs` was identified as the major contributor to disk utilization.
* At **10:30 AM**, Tomcat logs were approximately **126 GB**.
* Currently, Tomcat logs have increased to approximately **131 GB**, an increase of around **5 GB**.
* Total `/opt/tomcat` size increased from **133 GB to 137 GB**.
* Current `/opt` partition utilization is around **87%**.
* `catalina.out` is growing rapidly, with multiple rotated `catalina.out.*` files being generated.
* We observed repeated `NoClassDefFoundError` for `SubscriberPayloadValidator`, followed by HTTP 500 responses and retry attempts.
* Approximately **210 occurrences** of this error were observed in the current `catalina.out`.

**Actions Taken:**

* Performed first-level analysis of disk utilization and Tomcat log growth.
* Identified Tomcat logs as the primary contributor to the increasing disk usage.
* Checked `catalina.out` and rotated log files and identified rapid log generation.
* Identified the repeated `SubscriberPayloadValidator` error as a possible contributor to the excessive log generation.
* Aligned with **TAC, SRE, and Platform teams** for further investigation.
* Discussed with Platform team regarding the disk utilization threshold/configuration. As advised, we are currently monitoring the disk until it reaches **92%**.
* Platform team advised that there may be an existing configuration/action triggered above **90% disk utilization**, but the exact configuration is currently not confirmed.

**Current Status:**

* `/opt` disk utilization: **87%**
* Tomcat logs continue to increase.
* Further investigation is required to identify the root cause of the repeated application error and excessive `catalina.out` generation.
* Platform/TAC support may be required if disk utiliz...

openAlerts.Subject: Prod Platform Core H&M Canada – Rapid Disk Utilization Due to Tomcat Log Growth
openAlerts.subject: Prod Platform Core H&M Canada – Rapid Disk Utilization Due to Tomcat Log Growth
openAlerts.Description:
**Issue:**

While monitoring the disk utilization for **prod-platform-core – H&M Canada**, we observed continuous growth in the `/opt` partition due to rapid generation of Tomcat logs.

**Findings:**

* `/opt/tomcat/logs` was identified as the major contributor to disk utilization.
* At **10:30 AM**, Tomcat logs were approximately **126 GB**.
* Currently, Tomcat logs have increased to approximately **131 GB**, an increase of around **5 GB**.
* Total `/opt/tomcat` size increased from **133 GB to 137 GB**.
* Current `/opt` partition utilization is around **87%**.
* `catalina.out` is growing rapidly, with multiple rotated `catalina.out.*` files being generated.
* We observed repeated `NoClassDefFoundError` for `SubscriberPayloadValidator`, followed by HTTP 500 responses and retry attempts.
* Approximately **210 occurrences** of this error were observed in the current `catalina.out`.

**Actions Taken:**

* Performed first-level analysis of disk utilization and Tomcat log growth.
* Identified Tomcat logs as the primary contributor to the increasing disk usage.
* Checked `catalina.out` and rotated log files and identified rapid log generation.
* Identified the repeated `SubscriberPayloadValidator` error as a possible contributor to the excessive log generation.
* Aligned with **TAC, SRE, and Platform teams** for further investigation.
* Discussed with Platform team regarding the disk utilization threshold/configuration. As advised, we are currently monitoring the disk until it reaches **92%**.
* Platform team advised that there may be an existing configuration/action triggered above **90% disk utilization**, but the exact configuration is currently not confirmed.

**Current Status:**

* `/opt` disk utilization: **87%**
* Tomcat logs continue to increase.
* Further investigation is required to identify the root cause of the repeated application error and excessive `catalina.out` generation.
* Platform/TAC support may be required if disk utiliz...

allAlerts.Subject: Prod Platform Core H&M Canada – Rapid Disk Utilization Due to Tomcat Log Growth
allAlerts.subject: Prod Platform Core H&M Canada – Rapid Disk Utilization Due to Tomcat Log Growth
allAlerts.Description:
**Issue:**

While monitoring the disk utilization for **prod-platform-core – H&M Canada**, we observed continuous growth in the `/opt` partition due to rapid generation of Tomcat logs.

**Findings:**

* `/opt/tomcat/logs` was identified as the major contributor to disk utilization.
* At **10:30 AM**, Tomcat logs were approximately **126 GB**.
* Currently, Tomcat logs have increased to approximately **131 GB**, an increase of around **5 GB**.
* Total `/opt/tomcat` size increased from **133 GB to 137 GB**.
* Current `/opt` partition utilization is around **87%**.
* `catalina.out` is growing rapidly, with multiple rotated `catalina.out.*` files being generated.
* We observed repeated `NoClassDefFoundError` for `SubscriberPayloadValidator`, followed by HTTP 500 responses and retry attempts.
* Approximately **210 occurrences** of this error were observed in the current `catalina.out`.

**Actions Taken:**

* Performed first-level analysis of disk utilization and Tomcat log growth.
* Identified Tomcat logs as the primary contributor to the increasing disk usage.
* Checked `catalina.out` and rotated log files and identified rapid log generation.
* Identified the repeated `SubscriberPayloadValidator` error as a possible contributor to the excessive log generation.
* Aligned with **TAC, SRE, and Platform teams** for further investigation.
* Discussed with Platform team regarding the disk utilization threshold/configuration. As advised, we are currently monitoring the disk until it reaches **92%**.
* Platform team advised that there may be an existing configuration/action triggered above **90% disk utilization**, but the exact configuration is currently not confirmed.

**Current Status:**

* `/opt` disk utilization: **87%**
* Tomcat logs continue to increase.
* Further investigation is required to identify the root cause of the repeated application error and excessive `catalina.out` generation.
* Platform/TAC support may be required if disk utiliz...

closed.Subject: Portal 3 doesn't give out weight limit alert when creating LPN expectation
closed.subject: Portal 3 doesn't give out weight limit alert when creating LPN expectation
closed.Description:
Ongoing issue, no timestamps available.

Our inbound team reported that shortly after the latest build upgrade they have experienced an issue with pre put tool where the system allows the creation of the LPN expectation without giving the weight limit breached alert and only gives the alert when they attempt to finalize and release the pallets.

This is not a desired functionality, as the weights might reflect different in the packaging vs. inventory parameters. The team needs to know if the system considers the attempted put task over weight limit before they physically move the goods on to the rack.

You can find an image attached describing the error message, please let us know if you need further on-site validation.

Best regards,

Antti

closed.Description:
Hi Team,

We are experiencing an issue at TTP Station 102 while using the UD Putaway flow for putaway operations.

Tasks are being created and inventory/totes are being picked by the bots; however, the assigned Ranger is not arriving at the station. Currently, the tote is assigned to Ranger 17, which is positioned directly in front of Station 102, but it remains queued and does not proceed to the station for task execution.

This issue has occurred multiple times and is impacting operations at the station.

Observed Behavior:

UD Putaway task is assigned to Station 102.
Tote inventory is already picked and brought near the station by the bot.
Ranger 17 is positioned near Station 102 but remains in queue.
The ranger does not proceed to the station despite task assignment.
Similar incidents have been observed multiple times.

Request: Could you please investigate the root cause and advise why the ranger/bot is not being released to the station even though tasks are available and inventory is already nearby?

Attached:

Screenshot showing Ranger 17 queued near Station 102.
Screenshot of task assignment at the station.

Business Impact:
 Station 102 is currently down for UD Putaway operations, resulting in processing delays and reduced throughput.

closed.Description:

However, we are experiencing many situations where a box is physically full, but the system does not recognize it as such and therefore does not allow us to complete the bin full process because the option is unavailable.
As we are now picking a high volume of coats, the team is encountering this issue more frequently, and it is impacting our operation. 
Would be possible to add this option on the screen permanent? That way the user can decided if is needed or not at the moment,

closed.Subject: Urgent: SAP vs. GM Inventory Discrepancies Causing Inventory Compliance Risk
closed.subject: Urgent: SAP vs. GM Inventory Discrepancies Causing Inventory Compliance Risk
closed.Description:
Team,
While investigating the SAP vs. GM inventory discrepancies, I identified a potential interface/process issue that requires immediate attention.
Example: For material 1LSOO9102 , GM shows 3,359 units available, while SAP shows only 675 units, resulting in a variance of 2,684 units ($19,134.77).
Reviewing the impacted transactions, several SUs appears to have been inducted in Pandora but may still be pending completion in SAP. This suggests a possible communication or synchronization failure between the two systems, causing inventory to exist in GM without being properly reflected in SAP.
This issue is creating inventory inaccuracies, reconciliation variances, and compliance concerns. Can we please urgently investigate:

  *   Pending/stuck Pandora Put Requests
  *   Interface/API failures between SAP and Pandora
  *   Affected SUs and materials
  *   Corrective actions to prevent recurrence

Given the potential inventory impact, I recommend treating this as a high-priority issue and providing an ETA for containment and resolution.
GM Case # 00294591
Sap Ticket # A5045755L
Thank you.

closed.Subject: H80 – Race condition on WebSocket disconnect: bot closes connection before Safety Controller ACKs "unsubscribe"
closed.subject: H80 – Race condition on WebSocket disconnect: bot closes connection before Safety Controller ACKs "unsubscribe"
closed.Description:
We've identified a race condition in the H80's connection lifecycle with the Safety Controller (SC).

Context: Unlike previous models, the H80 does not keep a persistent WebSocket connection to the SC. It connects only when entering the station's buffer zone and disconnects when leaving it.

Issue: Before leaving the buffer zone, the bot sends an "unsubscribe" event to the SC and then immediately closes the WebSocket connection, without waiting for the SC's ACK. In some cases, the SC processes the "unsubscribe" and attempts to write the ACK response back on a connection the bot has already closed, resulting in an error on the SC side.

Requested fix: The bot should wait to receive the SC's ACK for the "unsubscribe" event before closing the WebSocket connection, instead of closing it immediately after sending "unsubscribe".

Impact: Intermittent errors on the Safety Controller caused by writes to closed connections, occurring on every buffer-zone exit cycle for H80 units.

closed.Description:
Hi GO Team,

After the cycle count, the inventory for DBG items is showing incorrect quantities. We observed an inventory discrepancy caused by an adjustment that was posted in cycle count, resulting in incorrect inventory being reflected in SIM.

Please let us know the RCA for why false adjustment getting posted after cycle count.

Shanavas

Hi GO Team,

Today, between approximately 4:00 and 4:30 PM, we experienced a very unusual issue at barcode 003.062 and three adjacent barcodes. (061 / 060 /059)

The following bots and MSUs were stuck in the same area at the same time:

• Bot 14191 carrying MSU 1406
• Bot 13190 carrying MSU 607
• Bot 14172 carrying MSU 826

closed.Description:
Hello,

After having version upgrade from 6.9 to 7.4.0.22 we have had issues with CG Breached racks. Initially there was 110 racks with this breach because some configuration value was set to 1000000 after the update. After the update we agreed to change that configuration value to 10000.

PROBLEM NOW is that these CG breached racks keep increasing (currently 114). And when we have to pick from those, systems asks to pick articles individually. So there might be a pick task for 10 pieces but we need to pick them one by one. This is REALLY slow. With version 6.9 we did not have this issue.

closed.Description:
Hi @GO Service<mailto:service@greyorange.com> team,

As part of our ongoing GO Roles and Permissions review, we are looking to better understand the current security model and access controls within GO.

Could you please provide detailed documentation for the roles, profiles, and permissions currently available in GO, including:

  *   A list of all available roles that can be assigned to users.
  *   The purpose of each role and the intended user group.
  *   The specific permissions and capabilities associated with each role.
  *   Any relationship between Roles, Profiles, and Permissions, including how access is inherited or combined.
  *   The menus, dashboards, screens, modules, and functions that each role can access.
  *   Any system-defined or out-of-the-box roles (e.g., Warehouse Manager, Team Lead, Supervisor, etc.) and their corresponding access rights.
  *   Any roles that are obsolete, deprecated, or no longer recommended for use.

We have identified several roles that are available for user assignment, but the permissions and capabilities associated with those roles are not clearly documented or visible within the application. This information will help ensure our role definitions align with GO's intended security model and support our user access review.
Additionally, if there is existing documentation describing the GO security architecture and best practices for role assignment, we would appreciate receiving that as well.

closed.Subject: Aritzia 1905- Enhancement - GO - Send Only One TakenOff Message Per Singles Tote
closed.subject: Aritzia 1905- Enhancement - GO - Send Only One TakenOff Message Per Singles Tote
closed.Description:
Opening on behalf of kprakash@aritzia.com and the ATZ team

Currently we are receiving a "takenoff" message for every single eComm
singles task picked into the same physical tote. 20 different orders picked
into a singles tote means 20 taken offs. Since there is only one tote
needing one move, 19 extra taken offs create unnecessary noise.

BY WMS only needs one. We are currently handling this through BY WMS by
ignoring / filtering taken off messages in a deferred queue.  This
enhancement request is to have GO not send extras in the first place.

Was a legacy request from E2E testing phase.

closed.Subject: EL-ATL - Tote K6009E5 Timeout and Status Inconsistency Issue
closed.subject: EL-ATL - Tote K6009E5 Timeout and Status Inconsistency Issue
closed.Description:
Summary:
[Conveyor / WMS Integration] Race condition: Late-arriving 'Put Complete'
event applied after tote timeout/rejection (Container: K6009E5)

Description:
A race condition and state synchronization issue was observed on 10/13/2026
during container processing for tote K6009E5.

After a scan timed out after 5 seconds and triggered a physical rejection,
a delayed processing event updated the tote status to 'Put Complete'. This
creates inventory state inconsistency in the system; if Outbound allocates
tasks to this tote, it will cause unassignment, unblocking errors, or
missing tote exceptions on the floor.

Impact:
Outbound allocation engines identify tote K6009E5 as eligible for picking.
Assigning picking tasks to physically rejected totes causes task
unassignment/unblocking errors and inventory discrepancies.

Requested Action / Remediation:
1. Immediate Data Fix: Check current status for tote K6009E5 and
unassign/hold it from eligible outbound pools until physically audited.
2. Engineering Guardrail Logic: Implement idempotency checks to ignore 'Put
Complete' status updates if a tote transaction has already registered a
Timeout / Rejected state.

Please let me know once the Jira ticket is created.

Best regards,

-- 

Best Regards,

*Isha Mahar*

Manager – Customer Experience

GreyOrange | www.greyorange.com

closed.Subject: CN4040 gStore: September Cycle Count Shrinkage Discrepancy Investigation
closed.subject: CN4040 gStore: September Cycle Count Shrinkage Discrepancy Investigation
closed.Description:
On Sep 7, There are 4 units for SKU 103188-SRMY-O/S, all of which should be counted in. The correct UPC is 191459314890. However, the UPC captured in the RFID discrepancy link is 198654157611. Due to this UPC mismatch, the system registered 0 units counted in. This issue was not included in the monthly shrinkage calculation at that time, resulting in an overstatement of 4 units in monthly shrinkage.
Can you please check the UPC mapping for the SKU 103188-SRMY-O/S at your end in Gstore ?

closed.subject: Support Required for Regional Inventory Snapshot Validation (SIM vs. GreyOrange) – 16 Oct
closed.Description:
Hi Team,
As part of the new POS live transaction feed enabled for GreyOrange, we have been validating inventory quantity updates between SIM and GreyOrange to ensure the latest inventory is accurately reflected in GO and available for customer-facing inventory searches.

North America (NA)
EMEA (GB)
China

closed.Description:
Hi GO Team,
Could you please verify that the STG environment is healthy and able to process picks and send the expected responses/messages?
While performing Cancel Order regression testing today, we encountered technical issues that were not seen in previous test cycles:

  *   One test failed with a screen error after scanning the first SKU.
  *   In another test, picking continued successfully, but SCALE did not appear to receive a response to the cancellation request.

The scenario being tested was a work order already In Progress, where picking had started before the cancellation request was sent. We expected GM to return a cancellation failure response, but that response was not received.
Please let us know once STG is ready for retesting. If needed, we can also schedule a working session with your team to walk through the scenario and confirm all required services are running properly including sending failure response messages on STG env .
Thanks,
Hassan Gabr

closed.Subject: gStore 2nd Line - ISR Pool Not Updating in a Timely Manner After Refill Activities - INC7162570
closed.subject: gStore 2nd Line - ISR Pool Not Updating in a Timely Manner After Refill Activities - INC7162570
closed.Description:
Hi Team, 

Store ID: CH0927. 

The store reported the following: 

Hi,

We conducted several tests yesterday in CH0927 to investigate the behavior of item localization and ISR Pool updates following refill activities.
Similar behavior has been reported by multiple stores in Switzerland (CH), the Netherlands (NL), and Austria (AT).

Test Scenario
We processed multiple replenishment lists using both options:

"No, I'll put them myself"
"Yes, put using gStore"

The results were identical in both cases, although the Store Manager informed us that selecting "Yes, put using gStore" should normally result in a faster update.

Localization Results
After completing the lists, all items were physically moved to the sales floor.

When performing a HAS on the items, the localization behaved as expected:
Within approximately 45 minutes, the articles were correctly localized in the appropriate sales floor zone.
This was observed consistently regardless of which completion option was selected.

ISR Pool Behavior
The behavior of the ISR Pool differs significantly and does not appear to update in a timely manner.

Observed behavior:
Once the list is completed and the items are moved to the sales floor, the articles disappear from the ISR Pool for approximately 15-20 minutes.
They then reappear in the ISR Pool roughly 20 minutes later.
The articles remain visible in the ISR Pool for at least 1 hour and 30 minutes, despite already being physically present on the sales floor and correctly localized via HAS.
Only after this period does the ISR Pool finally update and reflect the correct situation.

Business Impact
As a result, stores are unable to reliably perform refill activities every hour, as the ISR Pool does not accurately reflect the actual stock situation on the sales floor and appears to be updated with a significant delay.

This creates uncertainty for store teams and may lead to unnecessary refill tasks, reduced operational efficiency, and lower confidence in the ISR Pool as ...

closed.subject: gStore 2nd Line Missing/irregular hourly snapshots for US stores-INC7107889
closed.Description:
HI Team,

We are seeing an ongoing data quality issue in vw_raw_inventory_hourly affecting a large number of US stores.

The inventory snapshots are expected to be delivered approximately once per hour. 
However, for many US stores we are receiving multiple snapshots within the same hour while other hours are completely missing.

This issue was previously reported and we understood that it should have been fixed from 2026-08-26, but our analysis shows that the problem continued after this date and is still visible in the data.

For example, for US0370 on 2026-09-08 we received 23 snapshot timestamps, but these only cover 18 distinct hours. Several hours contain two snapshots while other hours have no snapshot at all.

Examples of duplicate snapshots within the same hour:
04:00:17
04:32:14

08:03:52
08:32:26

11:04:22
11:33:51

16:02:39
16:33:22

18:01:59
18:32:13

At country level, our check for 2026-09-08 shows:
Country: US
Stores with data: 315
Stores with fewer than 20 distinct hourly snapshots: 128

closed.Subject: Race condition between zone pause and resume requests leaves waypoints blocked
closed.subject: Race condition between zone pause and resume requests leaves waypoints blocked
closed.Description:
We identified a race condition when the pause and resume operations for the same zone are submitted within a short time interval.
Although the reproduction example below uses BRFFSP15 Staging, the issue is not limited to staging. We have observed the same behavior across the other sites as well.
When a resume request is sent while the preceding pause request is still being processed, both API requests return successful responses. However, the resulting state is inconsistent:
- The zone is reported by the API as resumed/unblocked.
- The waypoints associated with the zone remain blocked.
- Robots cannot use those waypoints, disrupting robotics operations.
Sending another resume request does not resolve the inconsistency because the zone state is already recorded as resumed. To recover, we must send another pause, wait for it to complete, and then send resume again.
Steps to reproduce
1. Send the following request:
POST https://brffsp15-stg.greymatter.greyorange.com/api-gateway/maop-service/zone/Zone-5/pause
Authorization: <token>
Content-Type: application/json

{
  "reason": "default_reason"
}
2. Without waiting for the response or completion of the pause operation, immediately send:
POST https://brffsp15-stg.greymatter.greyorange.com/api-gateway/maop-service/zone/Zone-5/resume
Authorization: <token>
Content-Type: application/json

{
  "reasons": [
    "default_reason"
  ]
}
3. Confirm that both requests return successful HTTP responses.
4. Check the zone status and the status of its associated waypoints.
For other sites, the same test can be performed by replacing the base URL with the corresponding site URL.
Actual result
The API reports the zone as resumed/unblocked, but the associated waypoints remain blocked. A subsequent resume request also returns successfully but does not unblock the waypoints.
Expected result
Concurrent or closely timed pause and resume requests for the same zone should be processed in the order in which they were received. The final state of...

closed.Subject: Request for GO support: pick_front data nesting and order line granularity
closed.subject: Request for GO support: pick_front data nesting and order line granularity
closed.Description:
Hello GO team,
We need your support from the D&A Supply Chain Aritzia team to understand how pick orders data behaves when data is nested. We likely need to expose data by order line, so we know which order lines are part of the summed quantity.
Issue

  *   Need more details about pick orders work when data is nested
  *   Probably will need the data open by orderline
  *   We need order line granularity data to identify which order lines are included in the summed quantity

Impact

  *   Without granularity, totals may be misrepresented or ambiguous

Scope

  *   Table: pick_front

Request

  *   Clarify data model and nested data handling for pick orders
  *   Define validation approach to ensure sums match when drilling into order lines
  *
A plan with timeline; we can provide a data sample

Thanks in advance,

Best regards,

Andres Fabian Pineda Martinez
Analytics Engineer Contractor, Supply Chain & Analytics Engineering
Bogotá, Colombia (GMT -5)
apineda@aritzia.com | Mobile +57 3160566950

closed.Subject: Issue: "Already scanned" error during Audit Damage Exception
closed.subject: Issue: "Already scanned" error during Audit Damage Exception
closed.Description:
Summary
During an audit, flagging an item as damaged always triggers an "Already scanned" error when the item is scanned in the damage exception flow. This happens regardless of the order of steps. Operators can tap OK and finish the process, but the error should not appear in this case.

Steps to reproduce: Flow 1 (exception before item scan)

      1.    Pallet/rack arrives at the station.
      2.    Scan the rack.
      3.    Tap Exception at the top, then select Damage Exception.
      4.    Scan the item.
      5.    Result: an "Already scanned" error appears.

Steps to reproduce: Flow 2 (item scanned first)

      1.    Rack arrives at the station.
      2.    Scan the rack.
      3.    Scan the item.
      4.    Operator sees the damage, taps Exception, then Damage Exception.
      5.    Scan the item again.
      6.    Result: the same "Already scanned" error appears.

Current workaround
Tap OK on the error and continue. The damage exception still completes.

Expected behavior
Scanning an item inside the damage exception flow should not show "Already scanned." The error should only appear for a true duplicate scan, such as scanning the same unit twice for the same count.

Impact
The false error happens on every damage exception. It slows operators down, trains them to dismiss errors without reading them, and could hide real duplicate-scan problems.

If you can add the screen or software version, station ID, and a screenshot of the error, it will help the team reproduce it faster.


[Company logo]<https://www.exol.com>



Emanuel Rivera

Warehouse Supervisor

M: +1 386-546-7565

The Robotic Logistics Platform™ built for tomorrow. | www.exol.com<https://www.exol.com>
